title: importLibrary creates a duplicate, permanently orphaned summary row for every book it skips
detail: CORRECTED after building a probe — the original wording said 'overwrites', which is wrong. summaryRepo.upsert keys on the summary's own id, and that id differs between devices, so the backup's summary is stored ALONGSIDE the local one rather than replacing it. Verified: 1 summary row before import, 2 after. getByBook then returns whichever sorts first by primary key, so which summary the app shows is arbitrary. Worse, books.remove called getByBook (singular) and deleted only one, so the orphan survived deleting the book itself and accumulated one more row per book per import. Fixed by writing a summary only for books actually imported or with no summary yet, skipping summaries whose book is absent or belongs to another profile, and adding summaries.removeByBook so deletion is complete.

title: importLibrary is not idempotent
detail: Running the same import twice reports added=0 but rewrites every summary again. A retry after a partial failure is not safe.

title: 'quota' substring is tested before HTTP status, so 429 rate-limits are reported as exhausted quota
detail: Gemini's 429 body reads 'You exceeded your current quota'. The includes('quota') branch wins before status===429 is ever reached, so a transient rate-limit tells the user their quota is used up and to check AI Studio.

title: statusOf() dereferences error without a null guard; toAiError(null) throws inside the error handler
detail: (error as {status?:unknown}).status on null/undefined raises TypeError, so the normaliser itself crashes on the exact inputs it exists to tame.

title: HTTP 400 mapped to 'invalid-key'
detail: 400 is usually a malformed or oversized request, not a bad key. An over-limit PDF upload tells the user their API key was rejected.

title: books.remove spans four independent transactions with no atomicity
detail: summary, blobs, review cards and the book are deleted in separate transactions. A failure midway leaves orphaned rows that nothing ever collects.

title: profiles.remove is non-atomic; partial failure orphans an entire library
detail: Books are removed via Promise.all then the profile row is deleted. If any book removal rejects, the profile is still deleted and its books become unreachable rows keyed to a profileId that no longer exists.

title: reviewCards.listByProfile full-scans every card of every profile
detail: getAll() then an in-memory profileId filter, despite the by-profile-due index existing in the v1 schema. listDue() inherits it, so the Review page cost grows with total cards across all profiles.

title: reviewCards.listByBook full-scans the card store, and books.remove calls it per book
detail: Deleting N books performs N full scans of reviewCards. Deleting a 300-book Goodreads import is 300 full table scans.

title: crypto.randomUUID() is undefined outside a secure context — any plain-HTTP deploy throws on first write
detail: randomUUID is gated on isSecureContext. GitHub Pages is HTTPS so the documented deploy is fine, but self-hosting on http:// or a LAN IP makes profile creation, add-book and summary save all throw TypeError with no fallback.

title: getDb() has no failure path
detail: If IndexedDB is unavailable (Firefox private browsing, blocked site data, storage pressure) openDB rejects and the rejection surfaces as an unhandled boot error rather than an explanation.

title: openDB registers no blocked/blocking/terminated handlers
detail: With DB_VERSION at 1 nothing upgrades yet, but the first version bump will deadlock silently for any user with a second tab open.

title: Migration gives every legacy book a summaryId and an empty Summary row
detail: summaryId is assigned unconditionally, so a legacy 'Want to Read' book that never had a summary gets one made of empty strings. Downstream 'is this summarised?' checks that key off summaryId then disagree with the ones that key off oneSentenceTakeaway.

title: finishedAt is never populated for migrated 'Finished' books
detail: The legacy record has no equivalent and none is synthesised, so migrated books cannot count toward any month and the monthly goal under-reports permanently.

title: testApiKey burns a full generateContent call on the summary model
detail: Key validation costs a real inference on every save. A models.list call would validate credentials for free.

title: No timeout or AbortSignal on any Gemini call
detail: summarize, chat, quiz, tts and recommend all await the SDK with no deadline and no cancel path. A hung request leaves the UI spinning forever with no way to back out.

title: summarizePdf inlines the whole PDF with no size check
detail: Gemini's inline-data limit is ~20MB. A larger upload 400s, and per S005 that 400 is then reported as an invalid API key — two bugs chaining into a completely misleading message.

title: Category enum is exported but nothing consumes it
detail: Book.category is typed `string`. The enum is dead weight that reads like a constraint the code does not actually enforce.

title: importLibrary preserves the source book id and put()s it
detail: books.create honours input.id, and put overwrites. A backup carrying an id that already exists under a different profile silently reassigns that book instead of importing a copy.

title: selectProfile silently no-ops on an unknown id
detail: Returns without setting state or reporting anything, so a stale deep link to a deleted profile just does nothing.
